## Rendering theory and textbooks

- Kajiya, J. T. (1986). The rendering equation. *Proc. SIGGRAPH ’86, Computer Graphics*, *20*(4), 143–150. https://doi.org/10.1145/15922.15902 — *Reflection/rendering equation background (phases 00, 07)* `[T1]`
- Pharr, M., Jakob, W., & Humphreys, G. (2023). *Physically based rendering: From theory to implementation* (4th ed.). https://www.pbr-book.org/4ed/Reflection_Models/Further_Reading — *BRDF, microfacet, sampling reference (phases 07, 08)* `[T2]`
- Veach, E. (1997). *Robust Monte Carlo methods for light transport simulation*. https://graphics.stanford.edu/papers/veach_thesis/thesis-bw.pdf — *Reciprocity, importance sampling theory (phases 08, 17)* `[T3]`
- Weyrich, T., Lawrence, J., Lensch, H. P. A., Rusinkiewicz, S., & Zickler, T. (2009). Principles of appearance acquisition and representation. *Foundations and Trends in Computer Graphics and Vision*, *4*(2), 75–191. https://doi.org/10.1561/0600000022 — *Measurement-to-representation overview (phases 00, 08, 09)* `[T4]`
- Montes, R., & Ureña, C. (2012). *An overview of BRDF models*. https://digibug.ugr.es/bitstream/handle/10481/19751/rmontes_LSI-2012-001TR.pdf — *Model catalogue for choosing fits (phases 07, 08)* `[T5]`
- Nimier-David, M., Vicini, D., Zeltner, T., & Jakob, W. (2019). Mitsuba 2: A retargetable forward and inverse renderer. *ACM Transactions on Graphics*, *38*(6), 203. https://doi.org/10.1145/3355089.3356498 — *Differentiable reference renderer for fit checks (phase 17)* `[T6]`
- Mitsuba 3 documentation. (n.d.). *BSDFs*. https://mitsuba.readthedocs.io/en/stable/src/generated/plugins_bsdfs.html — *Render fitted vs RGL measured BSDF (phase 17)* `[T7]`

## Classic analytic reflectance models

- Phong, B. T. (1975). Illumination for computer generated pictures. *Communications of the ACM*, *18*(6), 311–317. https://doi.org/10.1145/360825.360839 — *Baseline lobe model for comparisons (phase 07)* `[T8]`
- Blinn, J. F. (1977). Models of light reflection for computer synthesized pictures. *Proc. SIGGRAPH ’77*. https://doi.org/10.1145/563858.563893 — *Half-vector lobe, legacy export mapping (phase 07)* `[T9]`
- Torrance, K. E., & Sparrow, E. M. (1967). Theory for off-specular reflection from roughened surfaces. *Journal of the Optical Society of America*, *57*(9), 1105–1114. https://doi.org/10.1364/JOSA.57.001105 — *Microfacet theory, off-specular peak (phase 08)* `[T10]`
- Trowbridge, T. S., & Reitz, K. P. (1975). Average irregularity representation of a rough surface for ray reflection. *Journal of the Optical Society of America*, *65*(5), 531–536. https://doi.org/10.1364/JOSA.65.000531 — *Origin of GGX/TR distribution (phase 07)* `[T11]`
- Smith, B. G. (1967). Geometrical shadowing of a random rough surface. *IEEE Transactions on Antennas and Propagation*, *15*(5), 668–671. https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/1967ITAP...15..668S/abstract — *Smith masking-shadowing term (phases 07, 08)* `[T12]`
- Oren, M., & Nayar, S. K. (1994). Generalization of Lambert’s reflectance model. *Proc. SIGGRAPH ’94*. https://doi.org/10.1145/192161.192213 — *Rough-diffuse alternative to Lambert (phases 07, 08)* `[T13]`
- Lafortune, E. P. F., Foo, S.-C., Torrance, K. E., & Greenberg, D. P. (1997). Non-linear approximation of reflectance functions. *Proc. SIGGRAPH ’97*. https://doi.org/10.1145/258734.258801 — *Multi-lobe fit, retroreflection (phase 08)* `[T14]`
- Ashikhmin, M., & Shirley, P. (2000). An anisotropic Phong BRDF model. *Journal of Graphics Tools*, *5*(2), 25–32. https://doi.org/10.1080/10867651.2000.10487522 — *Anisotropic fit alternative (phase 09)* `[T15]`
- Rusinkiewicz, S. (1998). A new change of variables for efficient BRDF representation. *Rendering Techniques ’98*. https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-7091-6453-2_2 — *Half/difference angle data layout (phases 08, 17)* `[T16]`

## Microfacet theory and sampling (modern)

- Heitz, E. (2014). Understanding the masking-shadowing function in microfacet-based BRDFs. *Journal of Computer Graphics Techniques*, *3*(2), 48–107. https://jcgt.org/published/0003/02/03/paper.pdf — *Correct Smith G for GGX fit (phases 07, 08)* `[T17]`
- Heitz, E., & d’Eon, E. (2014). Importance sampling microfacet-based BSDFs using the distribution of visible normals. *Computer Graphics Forum*, *33*(4), 103–112. https://doi.org/10.1111/cgf.12417 — *Sampling fitted GGX in renders (phases 14, 17)* `[T18]`
- Heitz, E. (2018). Sampling the GGX distribution of visible normals. *Journal of Computer Graphics Techniques*, *7*(4), 1–13. https://jcgt.org/published/0007/04/01/paper.pdf — *Simple VNDF sampler code (phase 14)* `[T19]`
- Dupuy, J., & Benyoub, A. (2023). Sampling visible GGX normals with spherical caps. *Computer Graphics Forum*, *42*(8). https://doi.org/10.1111/cgf.14867 — *Faster VNDF sampling (phase 14)* `[T20]`
- Heitz, E., Hanika, J., d’Eon, E., & Dachsbacher, C. (2016). Multiple-scattering microfacet BSDFs with the Smith model. *ACM Transactions on Graphics*, *35*(4), 58. https://doi.org/10.1145/2897824.2925943 — *Energy loss at high roughness (phase 08)* `[T21]`
- Turquin, E. (2019). *Practical multiple scattering compensation for microfacet models*. https://blog.selfshadow.com/publications/turquin/ms_comp_final.pdf — *Energy compensation when fitting rough metals (phase 07)* `[T22]`
- Bagher, M. M., Soler, C., & Holzschuch, N. (2012). Accurate fitting of measured reflectances using a shifted gamma micro-facet distribution. *Computer Graphics Forum*, *31*(4). https://inria.hal.science/hal-00702304 — *Long-tail NDF fitting option (phase 17)* `[T23]`
- Ribardière, M., Bringier, B., Meneveaux, D., & Simonot, L. (2017). STD: Student’s t-distribution of slopes for microfacet based BSDFs. *Computer Graphics Forum*, *36*(2). https://doi.org/10.1111/cgf.13137 — *Generalised GGX tail fitting (phase 17)* `[T24]`
